title: release_token.v1
description: The claims of a release token (06_AgentZone/02_Compliance_Engine.md): a JWT the compliance authority signs only for a stored PASS evaluation, and the deployment guard consumes once. The header must match $defs/header: RS256 only, with the signing key's kid; any other alg, including none, is refused. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by issuer and guard and covered by vectors: nbf >= iat, exp > nbf, and exp - iat <= 900 seconds; the guard allows at most 60 seconds of clock skew; jti is consumed atomically, so a replayed or raced token is refused. artifact_digest is sha256 over the canonical identity of the evaluated artifact, never the raw identity.

sub.description: The repository the artifact was built from.

aud.description: The deployment guard for one environment; it must equal deploy-guard:<environment>.

jti.description: Single use: the guard consumes it atomically.

eval_run_id.description: The stored evaluation record that passed.

contract_version.description: The compliance_submission contract the evaluation used.

numeric_date.description: Seconds since the epoch (RFC 7519 NumericDate), whole seconds.
